reader_summary.overview: I happily accept some of the risks of a consumption-based model because I think that the benefits far exceed the cost. These providers need to be held accountable to continuously delivering value. It is not okay to simply sell a deal, walk away for 11 months, and then one month before the renewal is set to go.
